android_mechanism: Preferred repository metadata recomputed for every catalog row; fix precomputes it once
bug_description: ArticleComponent calls TextUtils.htmlDecode on title, desc and chapterName every time a list item is built. The feed list uses plain ForEach, so opening the home/search/square lists and every re-render during scrolling re-runs 12 replaceAll passes per field across all accumulated items, multiplying decode work on the render path.
fix_summary: HTML entities are decoded once when article data arrives (TextUtils.decodeArticleList applied in fetchData/search/loadList); list items render the already-decoded fields.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 3 vs 1 decode calls per rendered item (docs/analysis/measurement-html-decode.md)

mechanism_oracle.definition: Total CPU time of the app process during the fixed-duration scroll divided by number of rendered items, from hitrace; supplementary: count of string replaceAll invocations in JS stack samples.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows repeated htmlDecode execution on every item build (visible in JS sampling stacks); fixed executes decode only once per item at fetch. unfixed scroll CPU per item > fixed by >= 15%.

reproduction: git -C hosts/wanharmony checkout case/wanharmony_html_decode_per_render/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/wanharmony checkout case/wanharmony_html_decode_per_render/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
